stories.title: The Bilas Index: The best 65 men's basketball teams in 2026-27
stories.summary: It's that time of year again: Jay Bilas is here to name the 65 best teams in the sport. You're welcome.

stories.title: LIV Golf to wind down operations after failing to get support for 2.0 model
stories.summary: LIV Golf confirmed it is winding down operations after the league couldn't get the necessary financial commitment and player support to proceed with LIV 2.0.

stories.title: Harbaugh backs Herbert after Rams DB said Chargers QB 'was throwing deli meat'
stories.summary: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh, asked about Quentin Lake's comments on Justin Herbert's struggles against the Rams, says, "I don't see that."

stories.title: LeBron reps tell 'Bron AI' sports betting app not to use 76ers star's likeness
stories.summary: LeBron James is aiming to get a sports betting app to stop using his likeness without authorization, a spokesperson for the 76ers star told Front Office Sports.

stories.title: McIlroy handed 2-shot penalty, admits video 'doesn't look very good'
stories.summary: Rory McIlroy was handed a two-shot penalty after finishing his first round at the Abu Dhabi Championship, with officials ruling he improved his lie on a hole where he shot double-bogey to spoil his card.
